title: OrderPlacedV1
description: An order has been placed. Version 1. Immutable once committed: any change to this event's shape ships as OrderPlaced.v2.schema.json, never as an edit to this file.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this event instance, distinct from orderId, so a consumer can deduplicate a redelivered message.

occurredAtUtc.description: When the order was placed, in UTC. Maps to Order.PlacedAtUtc.

tenantId.description: The tenant the order belongs to. Required here even though the read model's TenantId is nullable: the contract is authored ahead of the publisher that will satisfy it.

correlationId.description: The correlation id generated at the edge and threaded through the request that created the order.

total.description: Maps to Order.Total. Computed by Orders, never by a caller.

lines.description: The order's lines. An order cannot exist with zero lines.

orderLineV1.title: OrderLineV1
orderLineV1.description: A single ordered line. Not independently versioned: it changes only when OrderPlacedV1 does.
